description: A system for designing and managing multi-level subagent hierarchies in OpenClaw. Provides explicit upgrade paths, quality gates, and capability unlocks across escalating agent levels. Use this skill only when the user explicitly asks to build, scale, or upgrade a structured hierarchy of subagents — not for ordinary single-agent tasks.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
